docstring: Selective State Space Model (SelectiveSSM).  Faithful implementation of Mamba-style selective state space recurrence block. Features: - State dimension (B, D, L, N) - Selective (input-dependent) Delta, B, C parameters - Structured A matrix initialization (Mamba paper Eq. 11) - Depthwise 1D convolution with SiLU gating - Bidirectional support with i
